notes: Replication data for statistical analyses in the manuscript "Male careers in wild Assamese macaques". Demographic and behavioral data on 100 male individuals have been collected 2006 through 2023 at Phu Khieo Wildlife Sanctuary on 1-5 groups of Macaca assamensis. Data include age at reaching different maturational stages and at dipsersal from the natal group and secondary dispersal after that. Dominance data are Elo scores reflecting wins in dyadic within group conflicts among adult males.
